value.rationale: Equal-size holes provide a natural dynamical escape-control problem. The result identifies a schedule minimizing survival at every horizon and maximizing escape, another maximizing it, exact nontrivial first-hit means (3 versus 5), and a sharp zero-entropy/countable-survivor phase distinct from every other periodic switching mode. The stronger all-time inequality and phase classification are not merely a numerical or arbitrary finite-slice computation.
